Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the retrieved information by stating the Bay of Pigs Invasion occurred in 1960. The WebSurfer results explicitly identified Francisco Jose Hernandez as a participant in the "Bay of Pigs Invasion" and mentioned his arrival in Miami in 1960. However, the Bay of Pigs Invasion historically took place in April 1961. The Planner confused the year of the individual's arrival/exile (1960) with the year of the invasion event itself (1961), leading to an incorrect final answer. This error aligns with the pattern of misinterpreting chronological data or confusing related dates (arrival vs. event) during the synthesis phase.
